about.title: About Us
about.markdown:
## 1. Who We Are
We Gadget BD is a premier destination for tech enthusiasts and gadget lovers in Bangladesh. We believe that technology should be more than just functional—it should inspire creativity, simplify everyday life, and deliver exceptional experiences.

Founded with a passion for excellence, We Gadget BD connects discerning customers with top-tier gadgets, accessories, and computing equipment with absolute authenticity and reliability.

## 2. Our Mission & Vision
- **Our Mission:** To empower people across Bangladesh by providing seamless access to genuine, cutting-edge technology with transparent pricing and exceptional customer care.
- **Our Vision:** To establish We Gadget BD as the most trusted and loved electronics destination in the nation.

## 3. Core Values
- **100% Genuine Products:** Every product in our catalog is verified and sourced to guarantee authenticity and performance.
- **Customer First:** We stand behind every order with dedicated after-sales assistance and clear guidance.
- **Innovation & Quality:** We curate products from globally renowned brands known for durability and technological leadership.
- **Integrity & Transparency:** Fair pricing, clear warranty policies, and straightforward customer communication.

## 4. Why Choose We Gadget BD?
- **Nationwide Coverage:** Fast and reliable delivery to all 64 districts in Bangladesh.
- **Official Warranty:** Trusted warranty protection with hassle-free support.
- **Secure Payments:** Multiple payment channels including bKash, Nagad, card payments, and Cash on Delivery.
- **Responsive Support:** Professional assistance ready to resolve questions before and after your purchase.

## 5. Get in Touch
Have questions, suggestions, or partnership inquiries? We would love to hear from you.

- **Email:** [support@wegadgetbd.com](mailto:support@wegadgetbd.com)
- **Phone:** +880 1576-641142
- **Address:** Dhanmondi, Dhaka, Bangladesh

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.markdown:
## 1. Introduction
Welcome to **We Gadget BD**. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy informs you about how we look after your personal data when you visit our website, your privacy rights, and legal protections.

## 2. Data We Collect
We may collect, use, store and transfer different kinds of personal data about you, including:

- **Identity Data:** name, username.
- **Contact Data:** email address, telephone numbers, delivery address.
- **Technical Data:** internet protocol (IP) address, login data, browser type and version.
- **Usage Data:** information about how you use our website, products and services.

## 3. How We Use Your Data
We will only use your personal data when the law allows us to, including:

- To register you as a new customer.
- To process and deliver your order.
- To manage our relationship with you.
- To improve our website, products/services, and customer support.

## 4. Data Security
We implement robust security measures to protect your personal data from accidental loss, misuse, unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure. Access is restricted strictly to authorized staff with a verified need to know.

## 5. Your Legal Rights
You have rights under applicable data protection laws regarding your personal data, including requesting access, correction, erasure, or withdrawing consent.

## 6. Contact Us
For questions about our privacy policy or practices, please contact:

- **Email:** [support@wegadgetbd.com](mailto:support@wegadgetbd.com)
- **Phone:** +880 1576-641142

cookies.title: Cookies Policy
cookies.markdown:
## 1. What are Cookies
Cookies are small pieces of text stored on your browser to recognize your preferences and improve your browsing experience.

## 2. How We Gadget BD Uses Cookies
We use cookies for:
- **Essential Cookies:** Remembering language preference, cart items, and security states.
- **Account & Login:** Keeping you logged in securely across sessions.
- **Analytics:** Understanding how visitors interact with our catalog to optimize performance.

## 3. Managing Cookies
You can control or disable cookies through your browser settings at any time.
